exposure: Stage of labor at time of emergency caesarean section
cohort: 259 women with a prior spontaneous preterm birth, 59 of whom had a term emergency caesarean section in a subsequent pregnancy
finding: Women with a prior spontaneous preterm birth and a subsequent term emergency caesarean section have a higher risk of recurrent spontaneous preterm birth than women with a prior spontaneous preterm birth alone.
mod_finding: Both first and second stage emergency caesarean sections are associated with an increased risk of recurrent spontaneous preterm birth.
